source_processing.battle: 9 original 1448×1086 RGBA sheets. Extract 4 × 3 cells. Crop transparent padding and box-resample to at most 80 px high. Feet align to bottom of each 144×84 transparent cell, nearest filtering in Godot. Exact cells are indexed in data/units/p11_sprite_atlas.json.
source_processing.portraits: Direct 1024×1536 generated edits to G11, G17, G19 and G32. Existing panel-only asset paths.
source_processing.fusion: Original 4 × 3 RGBA sheet, first three columns retained for F01-F03. The three cells of T03 were omitted because its ready and walking poses lacked the ash bucket. Existing T03 atlas remains in use.
